records.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: reusable transparent head artwork for a 2D story actor rig. Image 1 is the edit target: Karo's existing authored three-quarter-right neutral head texture. Create ONE corresponding FRONT-facing head (zero yaw) of the SAME Karo, not a new character and not a mirror. Preserve the hand-painted warm saturated orange skin, dark messy brown hair, black flowing ink outlines, rounded messy beard, moustache, ears and the exact visual family and proportions. Keep the complete hair/beard silhouette inside the image with transparent margins and genuine transparent background. No neck, torso, clothes, props, labels, tiles or extra head. Retain a SMALL warm skin aperture within the beard at the mouth position, with no teeth, tongue, smile line or mouth interior: separate rig layers supply the mouth. Make this a clean coherent front view usable between the existing left and right authored views. Do not flatten painted shading, make pale/white skin, enlarge the beard, add realistic skin detail, or change the hair color.
